signature.name: VTask.lc
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_2} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [Module R M] -> {ι : Type u_4} -> (e : ι → M) -> (l : ι →₀ R) -> M

conventions.statement: When the coefficient finsupp `l` is zero (empty support), `VTask.lc e l = 0`, the additive identity of `M`.
conventions.note: Follows from `Finsupp.sum` over an empty support being `0`.

conventions.statement: Any index `i` with zero coefficient does not contribute to the sum; `0 • e i = 0` and such indices are excluded from the support of `l`.
conventions.note: Standard `Finsupp` convention: only indices in the support are summed.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type*} (e : ι → M) (i : ι) (c : R), VTask.lc e (Finsupp.single i c) = c • e i

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type*} (e : ι → M) (l₁ l₂ : ι →₀ R), VTask.lc e (l₁ + l₂) = VTask.lc e l₁ + VTask.lc e l₂

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type*} (e : ι → M) (r : R) (l : ι →₀ R), VTask.lc e (r • l) = r • VTask.lc e l

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (e : Empty → M) (l : Empty →₀ R), VTask.lc e l = 0

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Type*} (e : ι → M), Function.Injective (fun l : ι →₀ R => VTask.lc e l) → ∀ (l₁ l₂ : ι →₀ R), VTask.lc e (l₁ + l₂) = VTask.lc e l₁ + VTask.lc e l₂
